title: Verify Technician cannot change a work order line status
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (Tech View blocks line status changes).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open the work order and locate a line.
2. Try to change the line's status.
expected: Changing the line status is BLOCKED: the status control is hidden, disabled, or returns a permission error.
